backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: Additive. Two RPCs are added (notices_v1, ops_notice_add_v1), two ops_notices check constraints are widened (old values kept), two app_settings keys (house_times, notice_sources) are inserted when absent. No table is rewritten, no row is changed, no grant to anon. notices_v1 reads weather_proxy_cache, ops_notices, inventory_items, verifier_findings (owner/admin), concierge_handoffs (owner/admin) and returns an allow-list; free text goes through staff_redact_v1. ops_notice_add_v1 is owner/admin (manage_operations) and refuses phone numbers, e-mails and amounts. Deploy weather-proxy (adds hourly, hourly_source, aqi, rain_watch, code) before or after: notices_v1 reads an old-shape cache without error (hourly [], code/aqi/rain_watch null). restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: notice_type_check_has_the_four_new_types_and_the_old_four
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'water' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'maintenance' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'deep_clean' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'note' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'brownout' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'holiday' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'event' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'reminder' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.ops_notices'::regclass and conname = 'ops_notices_notice_type_check'

forward_verification.name: source_check_has_the_three_new_sources_and_the_old_three
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'gscwd' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'manual' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'system' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'socoteco' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'ngcp' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ 'staff' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.ops_notices'::regclass and conname = 'ops_notices_source_check'

forward_verification.name: house_times_is_seeded_with_both_keys
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from public.app_settings where key = 'house_times' and value ? 'check_out' and value ? 'check_in')

forward_verification.name: both_functions_are_definer_with_an_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(prosecdef) and bool_and(proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc where oid in ('public.notices_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.ops_notice_add_v1(text, text, date, time, numeric, text, uuid)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: authenticated_and_service_role_may_run_both_anon_may_not
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.notices_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ops_notice_add_v1(text, text, date, time, numeric, text, uuid)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.notices_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.ops_notice_add_v1(text, text, date, time, numeric, text, uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.notices_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.ops_notice_add_v1(text, text, date, time, numeric, text, uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: notices_v1_source_names_no_money_or_contact_column
forward_verification.query: select prosrc !~* '\m(payout|price|gross_amount|guest_email|guest_phone|psid|payout_qrph)\M' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.notices_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: redaction_helper_is_still_internal_only
forward_verification.query: select to_regprocedure('public.staff_redact_v1(text)') is not null and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_redact_v1(text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_redact_v1(text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: notice_sources_is_seeded_with_both_pages
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from public.app_settings where key = 'notice_sources' and value ? 'water_page' and value ? 'power_page')

forward_verification.name: existing_brownout_notices_are_untouched_by_the_check_change
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.ops_notices where notice_type = 'brownout' and source is not null and source not in ('socoteco', 'ngcp', 'staff'))

rollback.safe_until: any time. Rolling back deletes notices of type water, maintenance, deep_clean or note saved after the release and nulls source gscwd/manual/system; take a backup first if any matter.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261014_s81_notices.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: drops both functions, restores the two original check lists (deleting rows of the four new types first), removes house_times only while it still equals the seed. The Staff v5 app hides Notices when notices_v1 is absent.

feature_flags.name: app_probe_hides_feature
feature_flags.required_state: None. The Staff v5 app probes notices_v1 and ops_notice_add_v1 and hides the Notices screen and the Add a notice form on PGRST202 (LANE-RULES rule 7). Nothing reads the new check values until a water, maintenance, deep_clean or note notice is saved.

compatibility.evidence: Read 2026-10-13 from the live catalog: ops_notices_notice_type_check = brownout|holiday|event|reminder, ops_notices_source_check = socoteco|ngcp|staff, 4 live rows, all brownout/socoteco; app_settings has no house_times or notice_sources key and no such key under another name; neither function exists yet. Readers of ops_notices.notice_type: staff_home_v1, calendar_day_flags, admin overview (they filter brownout or list the type as text), telegram-expense /notices (filters holiday/event/reminder or lists all). A new type shows only in lists that do not filter by type.
